recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a woman in a floral dress and braided belt, positioned in a sun-dappled forest setting with a bicycle. The composition features a prominent, stylized typographic lockup on the right side, utilizing high-contrast serifs and delicate line work.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed at the camera creates a personal connection.
Warm, golden-hour lighting harmonizes the subject with the natural background.
The heavy, cream-colored typography balances the visual weight of the subject.
Soft background bokeh isolates the subject while maintaining a sense of place.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large typographic display on the right act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the floral pattern of the dress, and then sweeps right to the large text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame uses the blurred forest as negative space to house the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm greens and earthy browns in the background provide a natural foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/Off-white used for typography provides high legibility against the dark forest.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty rose and muted pinks in the floral dress add a feminine touch.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the highlights with moderate saturation; the background is slightly desaturated to emphasize the subject.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Integrated decorative swashes and circular line motifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: First letter features an oversized, curled ball terminal
Last letter of the primary name integrates into a circular graphic flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, stylized display serif paired with a widely-spaced, geometric slab serif for a modern-traditional balance.
graphicDevices: Thin circular vector lines encircling the text
Soft drop shadow to lift text from the complex background

preserve: High contrast of the main serif
Wide tracking of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and ball terminals of the primary text.
Suitable for the secondary slab serif with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a woman with long brown hair in a floral dress, standing in a sunlit forest with a vintage bicycle. Use a shallow depth of field to blur the trees in the background. Lighting should be warm and golden.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, high-contrast serif name in cream color on the right side. Below it, add a secondary name in a widely-spaced slab serif. Add thin, circular line flourishes that weave through the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the text legible against the blurred background?
Does the typography feel integrated with the circular flourishes?
Is the color temperature consistently warm?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the decorative circular lines
mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific name or brand logos
Ensure the bicycle handles do not obscure the subject's face
postGenerationChecks: Verify the cream color of the text doesn't wash out in bright spots.
Ensure the circular flourishes are thin and elegant, not heavy.
Confirm the subject's expression is soft and engaging.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Forest Portrait + High-Contrast Serif + Wide-Tracked Slab + Circular Flourishes
